entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A Merfolk hydromancer and warlord who rules beneath the waves of the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar.

entities.name: Kapsho Seas
entities.description: The seas of Shandalar ruled by Talrand.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane where Talrand rules the sea.

entities.name: Kalyntri
entities.description: A dragon whose dominion above the sea Talrand challenged and who was killed by Talrand and a flock of drakes.

entities.name: Drakes
entities.description: Telepathic drakes who serve Talrand in exchange for his promise of an end to the tyranny of dragons.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A war during which many drakes and merfolk died protecting their waters.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Transplanar pathways that began to appear on Shandalar.

entities.name: Mistral Island
entities.description: An island on Shandalar where an Omenpath was found, claimed by Talrand as part of his territory.

entities.name: Alandra
entities.description: Talrand's daughter, sent to Strixhaven University.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane that hosts Strixhaven University.

events.summary: Talrand and a large flock of drakes kill the dragon Kalyntri.
events.quote: Talrand and a large flock of Drakes killed Kalyntri.

events.summary: After the invasion, Talrand works to contain horrors released from the abyss and defends his waters from human raids.
events.quote: Talrand, seeing his rule of the sea threatened, is working on trying to contain them.

events.summary: Talrand claims an Omenpath on Mistral Island as part of his territory.
events.quote: one was found on Mistral Island that Tarland claimed as part of his territory

events.summary: A letter arrives from Arcavios inviting Talrand's daughter to attend its school.
events.quote: a letter arrived from Arcavios for his daughter with an invitation for her to attend its prestigious school

events.summary: Talrand sends his daughter Alandra to Strixhaven University, to return only if she proves worthy to be his heir.
events.quote: Talrand sent his daughter Alandra to Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

relations.quote: The telepathic drakes serve him in exchange for his promise of an end to the tyranny of dragons.

relations.note: Killed with a flock of drakes.
relations.quote: Talrand and a large flock of Drakes killed Kalyntri.
Talrand sent his daughter Alandra to Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Talrand challenged the dominion of the dragon Kalyntri above the sea.
